Tinker's Magic|Artificer|EFA: Mending is a cantrip you know. Wielding Tinker's Tools, spend a Magic action to conjure a single item from a list of basic gear (rope, caltrops, lamp, manacles, and similar) in a vacant square next to you, no farther than 5 feet. Magic Item Tinker|Artificer|EFA: New options for Replicate Magic Item creations. Transmute (Magic action): swap one within 5 feet for another item from a plan you know. Charge (Bonus Action): touch a charged item within 5 feet, spend a slot of level 1+, regaining charges equal to its level. Drain (Bonus Action): touch one so it vanishes, giving a slot of level 1 (Common) or 2 (Uncommon or Rare), lost on a Long Rest. Drain and Transmute are once per Long Rest.
Spell-Storing Item|Artificer|EFA: Each time a Long Rest ends, touch a spellcasting-focus item or a weapon (Simple or Martial) and store an Artificer spell of level 1 to 3 in it. The spell needs an action to cast, no consumed Material component, and no preparation. A holder uses a Magic action to unleash it with your spellcasting modifier, concentrating if required. It can't fire again before that creature's next turn. It lasts for twice your Intelligence modifier uses (minimum 2) or until replaced.
Soul of Artifice|Artificer|EFA: Your magic items give you mystical support. Cheat Death: if you fall to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, you may disintegrate some Uncommon or Rare items made by Replicate Magic Item, and your Hit Points become 20 times the count disintegrated. Magical Guidance: finishing a Short Rest restores all spent Flash of Genius uses, provided you hold Attunement with at least 1 magic item.
Infuse Item|Artificer|TCE: You can imbue mundane objects with magical infusions, turning them into magic items far faster than ordinary crafting. Each infusion names the objects it suits, whether attunement is needed, and sometimes a level you must reach first. You can't learn one twice. After each long rest, touch a nonmagical object to apply an infusion, attuning instantly if required. It lasts indefinitely, but fades some days after your death (Intelligence modifier, minimum 1) or if you drop it.
The Right Tool for the Job|Artificer|TCE: Holding either thieves' tools or a kit of artisan's gear, you can magically make a set of artisan's implements appear in a vacant space within 5 feet. The work needs 1 uninterrupted hour, which can overlap a rest of either type. The creation is nonmagical and vanishes upon your next use of this feature.
Flash of Genius|Artificer|TCE: Under pressure, you find answers. Whenever you, or another creature that is visible to you and within 30 feet, rolls an ability check or saving throw, your reaction lets you add Intelligence modifier to that roll. Uses per long rest equal your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).
Magic Item Savant|Artificer|TCE: Your attunement limit rises to five items. In addition, none of the class, race, spell, or level restrictions on a magic item can stop you from attuning to or using it.
Alchemist|Alchemist|EFA: The Alchemist brews reagents into magical elixirs and potions, using them both to heal and to drain life. The subclass grants Tools of the Trade, Alchemist Spells, and Experimental Elixir at level 3.
Restorative Reagents|Alchemist|EFA: Lesser Restoration needs no spell slot and no preparation for you, provided Alchemist's Supplies serve as your Spellcasting Focus. Your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) sets the uses, and a Long Rest restores them all.
Armor Model|Armorer|EFA: Customize your Arcane Armor by choosing the Dreadnaught, Guardian, or Infiltrator model, each giving benefits while worn and including a special weapon. Attacking with that weapon lets your Intelligence modifier replace Strength or Dexterity on attack and damage rolls. Holding Smith's Tools, you may change models whenever a Short Rest or a Long Rest ends.
Dreadnaught|Armorer|EFA: Your armor grows into a towering brute. Force Demolisher is an arcane sledgehammer, treated as Simple Melee with property R, dealing 1d10 Force damage. Against a creature a size smaller than you or less, a hit lets you push it 10 feet away or pull it 10 feet closer. Giant Stature, a Bonus Action lasting 1 minute, adds 5 feet of reach and makes you Large if smaller. Uses equal Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) per Long Rest.
Perfected Armor|Armorer|EFA: Dreadnaught: Demolisher becomes 2d6, and Giant Stature adds 10 feet of reach, permits Large or Huge, and gives Advantage on Strength saves and checks. Guardian: Thunder Pulse becomes 1d10, and a Reaction can yank a visible Huge-or-smaller creature 25 feet toward you after its turn ends within 30 feet, if it fails a Strength save versus your spell save DC. A pull ending within 5 feet adds a melee attack. Uses: Intelligence modifier per Long Rest. Infiltrator: Launcher becomes 2d6.
Arcane Firearm|Artillerist|EFA: Once a Long Rest ends, etch sigils with Woodcarver's Tools onto a Staff, Rod, Wand, or ranged weapon of the Martial kind, making it your Arcane Firearm. Etching another item erases them, but otherwise they stay indefinitely. Your Artificer spells can use the firearm as their Spellcasting Focus. Casting through it lets you roll 1d8 and add the result to one of that spell's damage rolls.
Battle Smith|Battle Smith|EFA: The Battle Smith is part guardian and part field medic, skilled at protecting allies and mending gear and people. A Steel Defender of their own making fights beside them. The subclass grants Tools of the Trade, Battle Smith Spells, Battle Ready, and Steel Defender at level 3.
Improved Defender|Battle Smith|EFA: Your Steel Defender and Arcane Jolt grow stronger. Improved Jolt raises Arcane Jolt's bonus damage and healing alike to 4d6. Improved Deflection means that after Deflect Attack, the attacker suffers Force damage of 1d4 plus Intelligence modifier.
Cartographer Spells|Cartographer|EFA: Reaching the Artificer levels below grants these spells permanently prepared. At 3: Healing Word, Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt. At 5: Mind Spike, Locate Object. At 9: Clairvoyance, Call Lightning. At 13: Locate Creature, Banishment. At 17: Teleportation Circle, Scrying.
Ingenious Movement|Cartographer|EFA: Using Flash of Genius also lets either yourself or a willing visible creature within 30 feet teleport as far as 30 feet to a vacant space you see, inside that same Reaction.
Alchemist Spells|Alchemist|TCE: These spells stay prepared once your level in this class reaches the stated value, counting as artificer spells while ignoring your preparation cap. Level 3 gives Ray of Sickness and Healing Word. Level 5 gives Melf's Acid Arrow and Flaming Sphere. Level 9 gives Mass Healing Word and Gaseous Form. Level 13 gives Death Ward and Blight. Level 17 gives Raise Dead and Cloudkill.
Chemical Mastery|Alchemist|TCE: By 15th level, chemicals barely harm you and help you shake off ailments. Acid and poison damage are resisted, and you can't be poisoned. Greater Restoration and Heal cost you no slot, no preparation, and no material components if alchemist's supplies are your focus. Each spell cast this way is unavailable again until a long rest.
Defensive Field|Armorer|TCE: Use a bonus action to get temporary hit points matching your class level, replacing what you have. Removing the armor ends them. Uses per long rest equal your proficiency bonus.
Thunder Gauntlets|Armorer|TCE: With nothing held in it, each gauntlet is a simple melee weapon, and a hit does 1d8 thunder damage. The armor pulses distractingly, giving the struck creature disadvantage when it attacks anyone except you, until your next turn starts.
Armorer Spells|Armorer|TCE: At 3rd level, you gain spells that stay prepared once you hit certain levels. They are artificer spells for you and don't use up your preparation slots. Thunderwave and Magic Missile come at 3rd. Shatter and Mirror Image come at 5th. Lightning Bolt and Hypnotic Pattern come at 9th. Greater Invisibility and Fire Shield come at 13th. Wall of Force and Passwall come at 17th.
Perfected Armor|Armorer|TCE: At 15th level, extra perks arrive for your Arcane Armor, depending on which model you chose. Guardian and Infiltrator each have their own.
Arcane Firearm|Artillerist|TCE: At 5th level, you learn to turn a staff, rod, or wand into an arcane firearm for your destructive spells. After a long rest, carve sigils with woodcarver's tools to make the conversion. Carving a different object removes them, and otherwise they last. The firearm is a spellcasting focus for artificer spells. Roll a d8 whenever you cast one through it, and add the number to a damage roll of that spell.
Battle Smith|Battle Smith|TCE: Armies need guardians, and someone must repair things after defenses fall. The Battle Smith protects others and mends gear and soldiers, usually alongside a steel defender they created. Soldiers tell of being saved by one. At 3rd level you gain Tool Proficiency, Battle Smith Spells, Battle Ready, and Steel Defender. House Cannith battle work and the first warforged owe much to them.
Improved Defender|Battle Smith|TCE: From 15th level, Arcane Jolt and your steel defender improve. Jolt's extra damage and healing become 4d6, the defender gets +2 Armor Class, and Deflect Attack makes the attacker take force damage of 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier.
Brutal Critical (1 die)|Barbarian|PHB: Starting at 9th level, melee critical hits add one more weapon damage die to the extra damage. You get two more by 13th level, and three more at level 17.
Brutal Critical (3 dice)|Barbarian|PHB: From 17th level, a melee critical hit adds three extra weapon damage dice to the roll.
Restriction—Dwarves Only|Battlerager|SCA: Only dwarves can take this path, which fills a niche in dwarven culture of the Forgotten Realms. The DM may lift the limit when it doesn't suit the campaign or the setting the DM runs.
Tundra|Storm Herald|XGE: Activating this effect gives 2 temporary hit points to every creature you choose within your aura, as icy spirits numb their pain. The amount grows with class level: 3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th.
Bardic Versatility|Bard|TCE: Whenever a level gives you Ability Score Improvement, you may refocus with one change. Option one: exchange a skill you chose for Expertise with another skill proficiency of yours lacking Expertise. Option two: exchange a cantrip learned through the Spellcasting feature of this class for another bard cantrip.
Song of Rest (d8)|Bard|PHB: The extra hit points from Song of Rest rise to 1d8 at 9th level.
Bardic Inspiration (d12)|Bard|PHB: Reaching 15th level turns your Bardic Inspiration die into a d12.
Defensive Flourish|Swords|XGE: You may spend a use of Bardic Inspiration so the weapon deals extra damage to the creature you hit, equal to the die's rolled number. That same number is also added to your AC until your next turn starts.
Agile Strikes|Dance|XPHB: Spending a Bardic Inspiration use during any Reaction, Action, or Bonus Action lets you add one Unarmed Strike to it.
Divine Domain|Cleric|PHB: Choose a domain linked to your deity, each listing example gods. Picking it at 1st level grants domain spells and features, adds Channel Divinity uses at 2nd level, and gives more benefits at levels 6, 8, and 17. Domain Spells: each domain lists spells gained at set cleric levels. They stay prepared and don't count against your daily preparation limit. Any not on the cleric list still count as cleric spells for you.
Divine Domain feature|Cleric|PHB: Your Divine Domain gives you a feature when you reach 2nd level.
Destroy Undead (CR 1)|Cleric|PHB: From 8th level, undead of challenge rating 1 or lower are instantly destroyed if they fail the save against your Turn Undead.
Destroy Undead (CR 4)|Cleric|PHB: From 17th level, undead of challenge rating 4 or lower are instantly destroyed if they fail the save against your Turn Undead.
Thaumaturge|Cleric|XPHB: You learn one more cantrip from the Cleric list. Your divine link also adds a bonus to Intelligence checks made with Arcana or Religion, equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).
Subclass Feature|Cleric|XPHB: Your Cleric Subclass grants you a new feature.
Druid Circle|Druid|PHB: Upon reaching 2nd level, you select a circle of druids to identify with. The circle gives features then, plus more at levels 6, 10, and 14.
Druid Circle feature|Druid|PHB: Your Druid Circle grants you a feature at 6th level.
Warden|Druid|XPHB: Battle training grants Martial weapon proficiency and Medium armor training.
Chalice|Stars|TCE: You bear a constellation shaped like a life-giving cup. Casting a healing spell through a spell slot lets you, or one other creature near you (30 feet), regain 1d8 hit points plus your Wisdom modifier.
Martial Archetype|Fighter|PHB: You pick an archetype to emulate in combat style and technique when you reach 3rd level. Its features arrive then, plus levels 7, 10, 15, and 18.
Extra Attack (2)|Fighter|PHB: Starting at 11th level, each Attack action you take on your turn gives three attacks.
Indomitable (three uses)|Fighter|PHB: By 17th level, Indomitable has three uses between long rests.
Maneuvers|Battle Master|PHB: The maneuvers are listed in alphabetical order. You choose three of them, including Commander's Strike, Disarming Attack, and Distracting Strike among the options.
Improved Combat Superiority (d10)|Battle: Superiority dice become d10s at 10th level.
Telekinetic Thrust|Psi Warrior|TCE: After Psionic Strike damages a target, you may make it roll a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier). If it fails, knock it prone or slide it as far as 10 feet in any horizontal direction.
Psi-Powered Leap|Psi Warrior|XPHB: Take a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed of double your Speed through the end of the turn. Afterward it's unavailable until you rest (short or long), unless spending a Psionic Energy Die (taking no action) refreshes it.
Flurry of Blows|Monk|PHB: Following the Attack action in your turn, pay 1 ki point and make a pair of unarmed strikes using a bonus action.
Step of the Wind|Monk|PHB: Pay 1 ki point to Disengage or Dash as a bonus action during your turn. Your jump distance also doubles for that turn.
Monastic Tradition|Monk|PHB: At 3rd level, you dedicate yourself to one monastic tradition from those offered. It grants features then, plus levels 6, 11, and 17.
Ki-Empowered Strikes|Monk|PHB: From 6th level onward, your unarmed strikes are treated as magical when beating nonmagical attack and damage resistance or immunity.
Unarmored Movement improvement|Monk|PHB: At 9th level, you can run along vertical surfaces and over liquids during your turn without falling as you move.
Diamond Soul|Monk|PHB: At 14th level, ki mastery makes you proficient in all saving throws. After failing one, pay 1 ki point to roll again and keep the new result instead.
Perfect Self|Monk|PHB: At 20th level, rolling initiative while out of ki points restores 4.
Martial Arts Die|Monk|XPHB: Roll 1d6 rather than the normal damage for Unarmed Strikes or Monk weapons. The die size increases with Monk level, per the Martial Arts column in the Monk Features table.
Step of the Wind|Monk|XPHB: Dash is a Bonus Action for you. Alternatively, pay 1 Focus Point to use Disengage plus Dash as one Bonus Action, with jump distance doubled that turn.
Forms of Your Astral Self|Astral Self|TC: A monk's soul takes translucent form as the astral self, reflecting history, ideals, flaws, and ties rather than the monk's looks. A lanky human could manifest as a minotaur, and an orc might show gossamer arms and delicate features. Consider what drives your monk, such as obsession, justice, or selfish desire, and let it shape the form.
Shadowy Figments|Shadow|XPHB: Minor Illusion is a spell you know, cast using Wisdom.
Psionics|Mystic|UATHEMYSTICCLASS: Psionics is magic distinct from spellcasting, built on talents and disciplines. A talent is a minor effect needing no psi points. You start with one and learn more as the Mystic table shows. A discipline is a set of mental exercises powered by psi points. You start with one, learn more per the table, and may swap one each level. Psi points scale with level and return after a long rest. A Psi Limit caps energy use.
Mystic Order feature|Mystic|UATHEMYSTICC: Your Mystic Order grants another feature when you reach 3rd level.
Consumptive Power|Mystic|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: At 10th level, durability can be traded for psionic power. When you activate a discipline, hit points may cover its cost instead of psi points. You lose that many from both your current total and your maximum. Nothing can reduce this loss, and the maximum stays lowered until a long rest. It works once between long rests.
Potent Psionics (2d8)|Mystic|UATHEMYSTIC: Potent Psionics damage becomes 2d8 at 14th level.
Psionic Body|Mystic|UATHEMYSTICCLASS: At 20th level, psionic energy fills your body and your mind rises above it. You resist slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage, stop aging, and are immune to the poisoned condition, disease, and poison damage. On death, roll a d20. A 10 or higher means you discorporate at 0 hit points, unconscious, instead, and you and your gear vanish. You return where you chose, on that same plane, after 1d3 days with a long rest's benefits.
Avatar of Healing|Avatar|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: From 6th level, your aura of resilience works while you are conscious and capable of action. Allies who see you and stand within 30 feet gain extra hit points, your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0), beyond what a psionic discipline restores to them.
Awakened Talent|Awakened|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from Perception, Persuasion, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Deception, and Animal Handling.
Psionic Surge|Awakened|UATHEMYSTICCLASS: Beginning at 6th level, strain your psychic focus to break an opponent's guard. A target has disadvantage on the saving throw against your discipline or talent. Your active psychic focus ends, and it stays unusable through the next rest of either kind. Without access to psychic focus, this feature is unavailable.
Bonus Disciplines|Immortal|UATHEMYSTICCL: Pick two extra psionic disciplines at 1st level, both from the Immortal list.
Surge of Health|Immortal|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: Starting at 6th level, psychic focus helps you resist death. Use your reaction on taking damage to halve it. Active psychic focus ends immediately, and it stays unusable through the next rest of either kind. Being unable to use psychic focus also blocks this feature.
Bonus Disciplines|Nomad|UATHEMYSTICCLASS: Pick two extra psionic disciplines at 1st level, both from the Nomad list.
Effortless Journey|Nomad|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: Your mind mystically carries your body from 14th level. Each turn, once, give up movement (as much as 30 feet) to teleport that many feet, landing in a vacant spot you see.
Consumptive Knife|Soul Knife|UATHEMYSTIC: From 6th level, killing a hostile creature using a soul knife attack immediately returns 2 psi points to you.
Bonus Disciplines|Wu Jen|UATHEMYSTICCLAS: Pick two extra psionic disciplines at 1st level, both from the Wu Jen list.
Divine Sense|Paladin|PHB: Strong evil registers like a foul odor, and powerful good like heavenly music. As an action, open your awareness for a stretch lasting through your next turn. You learn where celestials, fiends, and undead lie within 60 feet, unless Cover blocks them, and what type each is, not who. You also notice consecrated or desecrated places and objects there, as with hallow. Uses total 1 + Charisma modifier, all regained on a long rest.
Sacred Oath|Paladin|PHB: At 3rd level, your preparatory stage ends and you swear a binding oath from the available list. It grants features then, plus levels 7, 15, and 20, including oath spells and Channel Divinity. Oath Spells: gained at stated levels, always prepared, and exempt from your daily limit. Non-paladin ones still count as paladin spells. Breaking Your Oath: lapses happen, and absolution comes from a cleric of your faith or fellow paladin, possibly via vigil or fasting.
Improved Divine Smite|Paladin|PHB: At 11th level, righteous might infuses all melee weapon hits. Every creature struck with a melee weapon suffers 1d8 additional radiant damage.
Divine Sense|Paladin|XPHB: Use a Bonus Action to open your awareness to Fiends, Undead, and Celestials. For 10 minutes, or until Incapacitated, you know each such creature's location and type within 60 feet. You also detect consecrated or desecrated places and objects in that radius, as with Hallow.
Dreadful Aspect|Oathbreaker|DMG: Using an action, the paladin pours dark emotion into a burst of menace. Creatures they pick within 30 feet that can see them roll Wisdom saves. Failure leaves the target afraid of the paladin for a minute. A frightened creature ending a turn over 30 feet away may retry the save to end it.
Abjure Enemy|Vengeance|PHB: Spend Channel Divinity and an action to raise your holy symbol and utter a prayer of denunciation at one visible creature within 60 feet. Unless immune to fright, it rolls a Wisdom save, with fiends and undead at disadvantage. Failure means frightened for a minute (ended by damage), speed 0, and no speed bonuses. Success halves its speed for a minute, also ended by damage.
Tenets of Glory|Glory|TCE: The Oath of Glory drives paladins to heroics fit for legend. Actions over Words: earn renown through deeds. Challenges Are but Tests: meet hardship courageously and bring allies along. Hone the Body: raw stone must be worked, and so must your body. Discipline the Soul: conquer inner failings that would dim your glory and your friends'.
Watcher's Will|Watchers|TCE: Channel Divinity can surround you with the protective force of faith. As an action, select visible creatures within 30 feet, up to Charisma modifier in number (minimum one). Through 1 minute, you and they gain advantage on saves with Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
Emissary of Peace|Redemption|XGE: Channel Divinity can amplify how you come across, using divine power. Spend a bonus action to gain +5 on Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes.
Dao's Crush|Noble Genies|FRHOF: Earth rises around whoever your Divine Smite hit. That creature is Grappled (escape DC equals your spell save DC) and, while Grappled, Restrained.
Marid's Surge|Noble Genies|FRHOF: Your Divine Smite's victim, plus creatures you choose inside a 10-foot Emanation from you, roll Strength saves versus your spell save DC. Failing creatures are shoved directly away from you for 15 feet and become Prone.
Primal Awareness|Ranger|TCE: Replacing Primeval Awareness, this option focuses your awareness through nature's links. You learn bonus spells at set levels if you lack them, outside your ranger spells known. Level 3 gives speak with animals. Level 5 gives beast sense. Level 9 gives speak with plants. Level 13 gives locate creature. Level 17 gives commune with nature. Each is castable once with no spell slot, then after a long rest again.
Martial Versatility|Ranger|TCE: At each level that grants Ability Score Improvement, you may swap one fighting style you know for another style open to rangers, reflecting a change in your martial focus.
Ranger Archetype feature|Ranger|PHB: Your Ranger Archetype grants a feature at 7th level.
Favored Enemy improvement|Ranger|PHB: At 14th level, you pick one more favored enemy and a matching language, ideally reflecting the monsters you have faced on your adventures.
Horde Breaker|Hunter|PHB: Once per turn while attacking with a weapon, make an extra attack with that same weapon on a different creature near the original target (within 5 feet) and in your weapon's range.
Escape the Horde|Hunter|PHB: Creatures making opportunity attacks against you do so with disadvantage.
Volley|Hunter|PHB: Use your action for ranged attacks on every creature inside a 10-foot radius around a point you see in weapon range. Each target needs its own ammunition and its own attack roll.
Roguish Archetype|Rogue|PHB: At level 3, choose an archetype to emulate in your rogue abilities. Its features arrive then, plus levels 9, 13, and 17.
Poison (Cost: 1d6)|Rogue|XPHB: Lace your strike with toxin so the target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failure leaves it Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn end and shedding the condition when it succeeds. A Poisoner's Kit must be on your person.
Subclass Feature|Rogue|XPHB: Your Rogue Subclass grants a new feature.
Obscure (Cost: 3d6)|Rogue|XPHB: Unless it succeeds on a save using Dexterity, the target is Blinded until its next turn ends.
Homing Strikes|Soulknife|XPHB: A missed attack roll made with your Psychic Blade can be boosted by rolling a Psionic Energy Die and adding that number. If this turns the miss into a hit, the die is used up.
Sidekick Class|Expert Sidekick|TCE: Becoming an Expert requires the creature to speak at least one language listed in its stat block. The class is meant for NPC sidekicks only.
Sharp Mind|Expert Sidekick|TCE: The sidekick becomes proficient in one saving throw of your choice among Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.
Potent Cantrips|Spellcaster Sidekick|TCE: Any cantrip the sidekick deals damage with gets its spellcasting ability modifier added.
Martial Role|Warrior Sidekick|TCE: Warriors train toward offense or defense, so pick one. Attacker: +2 on every attack roll. Defender: a visible attacker within 5 feet of the sidekick, aiming at someone else, suffers disadvantage on its attack roll when the sidekick uses its reaction.
Improved Defense|Warrior Sidekick|TCE: Armor Class of the sidekick rises by 1.
Second Wind Improvement|Warrior Sidekick: The sidekick can use Second Wind two times between rests.
Metamagic Options|Sorcerer|TCE: This adds two Metamagic options to those available when you choose Metamagic: Seeking Spell and Transmuted Spell.
Sorcerous Origin feature|Sorcerer|PHB: Your Sorcerous Origin grants a feature at 6th level.
Bolstering Flames|Spellfire|FRHOF: Grant Temporary Hit Points of 1d4 plus Charisma modifier to yourself or a visible creature within 30 feet.
Pact Boon|Warlock|PHB: Your otherworldly patron rewards faithful service with a gift at 3rd level. Choose one option, such as Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, or Pact of the Tome.
Mystic Arcanum (6th level)|Warlock|PHB: Your patron reveals an arcanum, a magical secret, when you hit 11th level. Select a 6th-level warlock spell for it and cast it once with no spell slot, then wait for a long rest. More arcanum spells follow: 7th-level at 13th, 8th-level at 15th, and 9th-level at 17th. A long rest restores every use.
Mystic Arcanum (9th level)|Warlock|PHB: Reaching 17th level, your patron gives you an arcanum, a magical secret. Select one 9th-level warlock spell for it. Cast it once without a spell slot, then rest long before doing so again.
The Archfey|Archfey|PHB: A fey lord or lady, legendary and holding secrets older than mortals, serves as your patron. Their motives may be inscrutable, whimsical, or aimed at power or ancient grudges. Examples: Titania, Oberon, Hyrsam, the Prince of Frost, old hags, and the Gloaming Court's ruler. Expanded Spell List: sleep and faerie fire (1st), phantasmal force and calm emotions (2nd), plant growth and blink (3rd), greater invisibility and dominate beast (4th), seeming and dominate person (5th). Fey Presence is also granted.
Bottled Respite|Genie|TCE: Using an action, you vanish into your vessel, which stays put. Inside lies an extradimensional cylinder, 20 feet in radius and height, comfortably warm and furnished with cushions and small tables. You hear the outside as if standing at the vessel. Stay for hours totaling double your proficiency bonus, or leave sooner by bonus action, death, or vessel destruction. You emerge in the nearest free space. Stored objects stay until removed or are released nearby. Re-entry needs a long rest.
Cantrip Formulas|Wizard|TCE: You have inscribed formulas in your spellbook for reshaping a cantrip mentally. Finishing a long rest while consulting them lets you swap a cantrip you know from the wizard list for any different one on that list.
Bladesinger Styles|Bladesinging|TCE: Bladesinging began with the longsword, then spread into styles for various melee weapons, each tied to an animal family with named specializations. Small elven schools teach them, mostly in Evermeet or Evereska, and students commonly receive a matching animal tattoo. Cat styles use swords: lion (longsword, no spell preference), leopard (shortsword, stealth and illusion), and red tiger (scimitar, defensive whirling then leaping strikes). Bird styles favor hafted weapons like axes and hammers.
Artificer Subclass|Artificer|EFA: Pick a subclass for your Artificer. Choices are Cartographer, Battle Smith, Artillerist, Armorer, or Alchemist. It is a specialty that unlocks features at set Artificer levels, and you keep every one whose level you have reached.
Flash of Genius|Artificer|EFA: As a Reaction, you can add your Intelligence modifier (at least +1) to a failed ability check or saving throw made by you or by a creature you see within 30 feet, which may turn it into a success. You have as many uses as your Intelligence modifier (at least one) and regain them all after a Long Rest.
Advanced Artifice|Artificer|EFA: Two benefits. Magic Item Savant raises your attunement limit to five magic items. Refreshed Genius returns one spent use of Flash of Genius whenever you end a Short Rest.
Magical Tinkering|Artificer|TCE: With artisan's or thieves' tools in hand, use an action to touch a Tiny nonmagical item and give it one lasting property: light (5 feet bright, 5 dim), a recorded 6-second message played when tapped, heard within 10 feet, a steady odor or nonverbal sound noticeable within 10 feet, or a fixed picture or up to 25 words. An action ends it. Items enchanted at once are capped at your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), oldest lost first.
Infusions Known|Artificer|TCE: Learn four artificer infusions, picked from the list placed after the class description. You learn more at levels listed on the Artificer table. Each level you gain here, you may swap one known infusion for a different one.
Artificer Specialist Feature|Artificer|T: At 5th level, your chosen Artificer Specialist grants you a new feature.
Magic Item Adept|Artificer|TCE: At 10th level, your grasp of magic items deepens. You can attune to four items at once. Crafting a common or uncommon magic item takes you only a quarter of the usual time and half the usual gold.
Magic Item Master|Artificer|TCE: At 18th level, your attunement limit rises to six magic items.
